quotes.quote: Small steps every day.
Consistency over intensity.
Your habits define your future.
Focus on the system, not the goal.
Every action is a vote for who you want to be.
Miss a day, not two.
Progress is rarely loud.
Show up. That's most of it.
One task at a time.
Depth beats speed.
This is the only thing that matters right now.
Let the timer hold the rest of the day.
Slow is smooth. Smooth is done.
Distraction can wait a few minutes.
You don't need motivation, just a starting point.
Close enough is a trap. Keep going.
Done is better than perfect.
Start before you feel ready.
Rest is part of the work.
You're allowed to go slow.
Momentum is built, not found.
The work you avoid rarely gets smaller.
